draft_rubric.name: S8 PR-summary rubric (draft for D20; LLM-free deliverable)
criteria: 1. What the PR does: stated in plain English without reading the diff
2. Scope: which components/files are affected, with no invented files
3. Risk flags: each flag cites a stored finding id (P6 acceptance criterion 2)
4. Confidence: the summary says what it could NOT determine
5. No false cross-references: every file->finding link is an exact path match (P6 acceptance criterion 3)
draft_rubric.aggregate: mean of criterion scores x 50 -> percent; reported with N and the frozen threshold
draft_rubric.freeze_rule: Thresholds are frozen before the final measurement run (Sentra_research.md §3.8 / D20); the rubric is not tuned after seeing results.
